chunks: And among them is Ahmad ibn Hilal al-Karkhi

key_terms.أَحْمَدُ بْنُ هِلَالٍ: Ahmad ibn Hilal, a specific narrator or figure
key_terms.الْكَرْخِيُّ: Al-Karkhi, indicating origin from Karkh (a district in Baghdad)

ai.seo_question: Who is Ahmad ibn Hilal al-Karkhi in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: Ahmad ibn Hilal al-Karkhi is identified among the prominent figures during the Minor and Major Ghayba who claimed deputyship or authority, serving as a key example in al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* of those scrutinized for authenticity. His inclusion highlights the rigorous criteria used by Shia scholars to distinguish true representatives from false claimants, ensuring the continuity of religious authority during the Imam's occultation.
